chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Allah's inheritance from His believing servant is a righteous child who seeks forgiveness for him.

key_terms.الْوَلَدُ الصَّالِحُ: a righteous child of upright character and faith
key_terms.مِيرَاثُ: inheritance or what remains behind from the believer

ai.seo_question: What lasting benefit does a righteous child provide to a deceased believing parent?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that one of the enduring legacies a believer leaves behind is a righteous child who prays for his forgiveness. The hadith highlights the spiritual value of righteous offspring and the lasting benefit of seeking forgiveness for one's parents after their death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4689 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Allah's (swt) inheritance from His (swt) believing servant is a righteous child who seeks forgiveness for him."
